articles.title: Rising Star Klugman Finds Positives in Defeat, While Sock Superstition Steals the Show
articles.summary: 17-year-old Hannah Klugman’s breakthrough week ended with a loss to world No. 27 Marie Bouzkova, but she’s taking crucial lessons to Wimbledon. Meanwhile, Alejandro Davidovich Fokina’s lucky mismatched socks might need special permission at the All England Club.

articles.title: Draper’s Long Road Back: Injury, a Ranking Plunge, and Now a Murray-Guided Return
articles.summary: After playing just 11 matches in a year, former world No. 4 Jack Draper returns at Eastbourne with new coach Andy Murray. The partnership could be long-term, but first Draper must prove his fitness before Wimbledon.

articles.title: Fery’s Queen’s Dream Ends in a Thriller — With a Smile and a Throat Shot
articles.summary: British wildcard Arthur Fery pushed world No. 27 Francisco Cerundolo to the limit in the Queen’s quarterfinals, even leading by a break in the third set. A bizarre net-cord incident left Cerundolo gasping, but the pair shared a wry smile in a match full of grit and grace.
